guidance.summary: Targeting around INR 5,000 crore revenue in four to five years
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: We feel that over the next four, five years, this business is going to be somewhere around INR5,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Total Capex expected between INR 1,150 and 1,200 crore in FY26
guidance.speaker: MR. SAURABH GUPTA
guidance.quote: I think so yes, by end of this year, we should be closing at a number of closer to anywhere between INR1,150 crores to INR1,200-odd crores total.

guidance.summary: Confident of achieving 50% growth in refrigerator business in FY26
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: The outlook for ‘25, ‘26 is very promising with healthy order book, and we are confident of achieving 50% growth this fiscal.

guidance.summary: Telecom business revenue target of almost INR 5,000 crore in a year
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: So, when you are looking at the non-mobile business, we feel that our telecom business in a year or so, can touch a revenue of almost INR5,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Refrigerator business revenue projected between INR 2,000 and 2,500 crore
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: We feel in a couple of years our refrigerator business because in phase one we are expanding our capacity to 1.2 million and then to 2.2 million can be somewhere between INR2,000-2,500 crores.

guidance.summary: Washing machine revenues targeted to reach INR 1,800 to 2,000 crore
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: The current revenues of almost INR1,200 crores may go to INR1,800, 2,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Lighting JV revenue targeted to double to INR 2,000 crore
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: Lighting through a JV, we are confident that from INR850 crores, INR 900-odd crores can double to INR2,000 crores.

guidance.summary: IT product revenue expected between INR 3,000 and 3,500 crore
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: We feel that in a couple of years’ time that again revenue can be somewhere in the range of INR3,000, 3,500 crores.

guidance.summary: Mobile export revenue expected to hit INR 7,000 crore in FY26
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: We feel in the current year of ’25-26 should hit INR 7,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Mobile export revenue projected to ramp up to INR 11,000 to 12,000 crore
guidance.speaker: M R. ATUL LALL
guidance.quote: We feel that this number of INR7,000-odd crores can ramp up to almost INR11,000, 12,000 crores.

guidance.summary: Camera module margin target of 9% to 9.5% over next couple of years
guidance.speaker: MR. SAURABH GUPTA
guidance.quote: We feel confident that the 7%, 7.5% margin can potentially go to 9%, 9.5% margin over the next couple of years.
